concepts.gloss_en: The covenant of salt (Num 18:19), an epithet for the tzaddik who sweetens bitterness; 'ברית מלח' is the shortened form of the same phrase

reason_for_human: Both occurrences use the salt-covenant phrase as a bechina of the tzaddik (occ:21 quotes the full 'ברית מלח עולם' from Num 18:19; occ:586 uses 'ברית מלח' but in the same context of the tzaddik sweetening the world's bitterness via salt). 'ברית מלח' is simply the truncated form of the same phrase/motif, not a different word — merge holds.
